speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in to discuss this breast mass. To help me understand your situation, please describe exactly what you feel, including its size, shape, texture, and if it is painful or changing.

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Carcinoma.

Based on your age and the rapid growth of a painless mass in the left breast, I suspect breast cancer. To confirm this, I need to see your recent imaging and feel the lymph nodes in your armpit. REQUEST IMAGES: Mammogram_Left_Breast. REQUEST TEST: Bilateral_Lymph_Node_Examination.
